To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we developed a process that is able to create a domain-specific architecture model based on the SGAM, that is applicable for smart grid projects, and that is supported by the SGAM-ToolBox.
the proposed process for the creation of Smart Grid architecture models is applicable and that the SGAM-ToolBox is a valuable support tool for this process.
a model-driven approach for smart grid architecture development is possible, that it is useful and that it is applicable in real-world scenarios.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of a model-driven approach to create Smart Grid architecture models, including requirements specifications, based on Smart Grid Use Cases.
the definition and application of a MDA-based process for smart grid projects, and with the provision of appropriate tool-support.
the question how to create and manage architecture models for Smart Grid projects in a systematic way, and to what extent this can be achieved by applying the MDA-approach.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the MDA-based approach for Smart Grid projects is a promising approach.
MDA-approaches in combination with the SGAM provide a promising basis for Smart Grid architecture management.
the SGAM is a good basis for the development of a Smart Grid Architecture Model.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the SGAM Toolbox provides a promising approach for the development of architecture models in the Smart Grid domain.
the MDA-process for Smart Grid projects is feasible and can be used in practice.
the SGAM Toolbox can be used to create domain-specific architecture models for Smart Grid projects and that the MDA approach is a feasible method to do so.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the MDA-approach can be applied to Smart Grid projects, and that the SGAM-Tool- box can be used for this purpose.
the proposed process is applicable for the specification of Smart Grid projects, which can be used to support the development of Smart Grid projects.
the MDA-process for Smart Grid architecture models provides an effective and efficient way to specify requirements and architecture models.
